data.rationale: The proposal follows the same procedure in the same order (Xe convert two quotes to USD, timeanddate city search, mail To/Subject/Body, then discard), but it splits each quote into amount and currency parameters where the true workflow has a single quote_a and quote_b. It also adds an extra recipient parameter and a vague "Discard or send" ending where the true workflow says never to send. Even so, the steps are concrete enough to automate.
